Dr Bubul Kumar Saikia
Welcome to Lakhimpur Telahi Kamalabaria (L.T.K.) College, a premier institution of higher education established on 22 August 1977 at Azad, North Lakhimpur. Founded through the vision and collective efforts of educationists and local citizens, the college has been serving the educational aspirations of rural and socially disadvantaged communities for nearly five decades.
